notes.title: Update - Beta v1.1
notes.content:
- New achievements:
  - TUSK IS BETRAYING THE NATION - Eliminate 4 pieces of the same player (can be your own) with one shot from the Wozdoopy Grenade. (idea: @wengiel)
  - TUSK WANTS TO TEACH CHILDREN... - Dry beat foreign horse meat 4 times in a row. (inspiration: @wengiel)
  - EDGING OF TUSK - Use your own piece to make a German agent fall off the board..
  - TUSK VS KACZYŃSKI - Capture a king with a king. (Idea: @Redmiguelito_G360 and @Wilq1)
  - TUSK LITTERS IN THE NATIONAL PARK - Throw a coin very far off the board.. (idea: @wengiel)
- Bugged lobbies with 1/100 players will no longer be displayed in the list
- Fixed bugs with selecting coin to rotate around on the Space key & now you can also rotate around enemy coins that have your SeaWeed on it
- Now you get 2 SP for killing with the Blow weapon
- Inflation can now convert enemy SeaWeeds i.e. when used on a SeaWeed it changes the owner of the SeaWeed to the one who used the Inflation
- Fixed converting enemy SeaWeeds with re-using SeaWeed on it in "anyone can move anyone"-mode (i.e. it will work now it the "Train alone" mode)

notes.title: Beta v1.0.3 - change log
notes.content:
- Restored displaying "Draw" & "*player-color* wins" when a game ends & fixed draw and first-win achievements
- Fixed the two-coins-land-on-one achievement when in client-only mode (when not being the horst)
- Fixed "check" (losing all pawns) when all kings of a player (e.g. in "Vatican" mode) fall off board in the same turn
- Knights will no longer bounce from coins with SeaWeed (i.e. pushing knights to water using Brushwood+ on coins with a SeaWeed will no longer work)
- Fixed "Target FPS" option showing -1 when disabling v-sync for the first time (now the default value is 150)
- Fixed "*player-color* eliminated" messages & added a message for the horst when he gets eliminated, suggesting not to leave until everyone else finishes
- Added warning when joining a lobby with a custom "Losing kings causes" or "Restore fallen coins" setting

notes.title: Beta v1.0.2 - change log
notes.content:
- Now you gain SP for killing an enemy SeaWeed
- SP will no longer be decreased if the coin killing other coin from its team is infected with an enemy SeaWeed
- Fixed auto-setting of "show subtitles" option
- Fixed bug with SeaWeed sometimes not colliding
- Mouse will no longer collide with SeaWeeds that are not fired (the ones that are still "attached" to the player before firing it)
- Fixed syncing state of SeaWeeds with clients
- Fixed bug where you could grind the 100 wins achievement by just moving random pieces after a win
- Fixed bug were inviting players would not work after exiting a game and not creating lobby again - it will auto-create the lobby now when you invite someone
- The code that checks if you have enough SP will now be skipped when unlimited special points option is enabled

notes.title: Beta v1.0.1 - Change log
notes.content:
- Improved blowing coins from longer distances (but it is still recommended to get really close to the coin you want to blow)
- Renamed option "Local multiplayer" to "Anyone can play for anyone" & added some new tips/warnings while in a lobby
- It's now a bit easier to move the Rook diagonally and the Bishop straight (reduced damping from 50% to 40%)
- Added information for players when the horst shuts down the server
- Fixed a bug that caused Inflation, Deflation and Hot Sauce weapons to kick players from the server after unlocking certain achievements (Tusk's fault!)

notes.title: Chess for idiots
notes.content: Chess for idiots - a discipline of intellectual sport, invented and initiated by Ozjasz Goldberg. Seemingly chess for idiots resembles regular chess. The game is played on the same board using the same pieces. However, this is where the similarities end, because everything that would discriminate intellectually against players was eliminated from the rules. Therefore, there are practically no rules, and players can make any move with any pieces and capture any number of opponent's pieces. The victory is determined by the IQ (the lower, the greater the chances of winning) and the decision of Ozjasz Goldberg.
